metadata.target_conclusion: There are 13 hostages inside the Aurelia cafe

attack_plan.narrative: The hostage crisis unfolding at the Aurelia cafe has seen intermittent escapes that suggest a larger initial number of hostages than publicly detailed. Early reports confirmed hostages were taken inside the cafe, with an Islamic flag displayed prominently in the window, signaling a tense standoff (544288799711592448, 544278335455776769). Throughout the prolonged siege, multiple individuals have fled the scene in small groups. Initial escapes involved three people breaking free, followed by two additional hostages emerging moments later (544367462012432384, 544373593841623040). Subsequently, two more hostages managed to escape from the cafe, bringing the total number of freed individuals to five, yet authorities have maintained an ambiguous count of those still inside (544379489263042561, 544383022876065792). Amid this, reports indicate seven people were transported on stretchers and five were receiving treatment nearby, figures that may represent only a fraction of those held captive, with others possibly uninjured and remaining inside unseen (544384394337611776). Witnesses from nearby newsrooms have observed the gunman moving hostages past the windows, sometimes holding them in view for hours, a sign that hostages may be confined within multiple rooms or sections of the cafe (544392801836728321, 544477097016578048). Police contact with the hostage taker has been ongoing, and movement inside the cafe continues even as the siege progresses (544362279006113792, 544477097016578048). The persistent emergence of small groups of escapees over an extended timeframe, alongside the reported number of those still confined, strongly suggests that at least a dozen hostages were originally taken. The complexity of the cafe’s layout and the strategic rotation of hostages within may explain the staggered escape pattern and the difficulty in confirming an exact count. While official statements have remained cautious, the pattern of escapes and ongoing hostage presence imply that thirteen hostages are likely still inside the Aurelia cafe.
